The BS requires no software engineering course and no capstone or senior design course (required: CISC 1400, 2100/2110, 1600/1610, 2000/2010, 2200, 3500, 3593, 3595, 4080, 4090, 4615, 4631, MATH 1206, plus three electives).

notes: The catalog page covers both BA and BS; the BS (16 courses) is taken. CS1 = CISC 1600/1610; CS2 = CISC 2000/2010 (CISC 2200 Data Structures follows). Fordham's university policy (AI use subject to instructor authorization) is not collected here.
